newsitem.title: NORWAY: Statoil invites bids for Aasgard gas platform.
newsitem.headline: Statoil invites bids for Aasgard gas platform.

text.p: Den norske stats oljeselskap AS (Statoil) said on Thursday it had invited three companies to bid for the construction of a gas production platform for the Aasgard field off mid-Norway in the Norwegian Sea.
Expected to cost around 10 billion crowns, the contract is due to be awarded early in 1997, the company's Status Weekly newsletter said. It did not name the companies.
The Aasgard B semi-submersible unit will measure 100 metres by 100 metres and have a dry weight of 30,000 tonnes.

The Aasgard prospect -- comprising the Smoerbukk, Smoerbukk South and Midgard discoveries -- will be developed in two stages with production of oil and condensate starting in 1998 and the gas platform coming on stream two years later.
